title: huperzia dianae
intro: Huperzia dianae, commonly known as the Dian's liverwort, is a species of liverwort that belongs to the family Huperziaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support liver and kidney function, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Huperzia dianae include its potential to protect against liver and kidney damage, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
